purpose: Machine-readable registry for manuscript-facing VeloGraphX evidence. Historical workflow publication_grade/research_claim flags are not modified by this registry.

evidence_policy.tier_a: Hosted same-run or paired comparative evidence with pinned revisions, explicit timing semantics, repetitions, and correctness gates; suitable for scoped relative manuscript claims.
evidence_policy.tier_b: Hosted supporting A/B or published-reference evidence with explicit provenance and correctness; suitable for narrow mechanism or algorithm claims.
evidence_policy.tier_c: Development or pending-audit evidence; not suitable for headline quantitative manuscript claims until the final retained artifact is audited/cross-referenced.

campaigns.scope: Current publication-preflight-v1 policy on checksum-pinned ca-GrQc, soc-Epinions1 and web-Google; three regimes per graph, five repetitions, one thread.
campaigns.correctness: All policies exact against fresh BFS; 1,610 adaptive batch samples.
safe_claims: Current selector remains exact across the evaluated graph families
Low average oracle regret on the evaluated fixed graph/root program
Zero internal fallbacks and zero obsolete one-sided-full decisions in this run

campaigns.scope: Focused current-selector tail validation on pinned web-Google across four regimes with three repetitions each.
safe_claims: Focused regression evidence for current publication selector and double-work avoidance
excluded_claims: cross-dataset generalization from this run alone

campaigns.scope: Native BFS/weighted-SSSP comparison against GAP and LAGraph at 1/2/4 threads with five repetitions per configuration.
campaigns.correctness: Independent engine correctness/self-check gates required before acceptance.
safe_claims: Same-run hosted relative BFS/SSSP behavior on the evaluated workloads
VeloGraphX hosted BFS wins while GAP hosted weighted SSSP wins
1/2/4-thread behavior on the evaluated GitHub runner

campaigns.scope: Native C++ VeloGraphX vs NetworKit DynBFS, one thread, three fixed roots, five paired repetitions per root on two datasets.
campaigns.correctness: 30 paired executions accepted only after exact full-BFS validation and nontrivial reachability gates.
safe_claims: VeloGraphX is faster on the evaluated web-Google campaign
NetworKit is faster on the evaluated ca-GrQc campaign
Workload-dependent winners support the non-universal crossover narrative

campaigns.scope: VeloGraphX deletion-aware repair, legacy full recomputation, and pinned RisGraph on the documented web-Google workload.
campaigns.correctness: 13 update batches with exact final BFS and independent verification.
safe_claims: VeloGraphX localized repair improves over its legacy full-recompute path on this workload
RisGraph remains faster than VeloGraphX on this documented hosted run
excluded_claims: combining absolute times with the separate NetworKit run

campaigns.scope: Exact dynamic triangle comparison against the published GoldenCounter reference at 1%, 5%, and 10% update batches with five paired repetitions per configuration.
safe_claims: Documented answer-ready latency ratios versus the published exact GoldenCounter reference on the evaluated workload
excluded_claims: claiming reproduction of the complete DZiG/SWTC architecture

campaigns.scope: Scale-aware vs legacy canonicalization policy on com-Orkut (234,370,166 directed arcs), 60 epochs.
safe_claims: Storage-maintenance A/B trade-off on the documented hosted Orkut run

excluded_claims: Use historical v3 metrics as current selector headline results

campaigns.scope: One-runner VeloGraphX / NetworKit / RisGraph campaign across multiple graph families and seven update fractions.
safe_claims: Describe the campaign contract as planned/executable evidence infrastructure
excluded_claims: Publish numerical results before all retained matrix artifacts pass audit

manuscript_rules: Do not combine absolute times from different hosted runner campaigns into one ranking.
Use paired same-run ratios where possible.
Preserve negative results, workload-specific winners, and selector tail failures.
State exact timing boundaries and machine class for every quantitative comparison.
Freeze selected raw results in a submission-era tagged/DOI-capable archive because GitHub Actions artifact retention is limited.
